Subject: Questions on Redwood DPA + SCCs for Order Form

Neha —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the order form draft. A couple of questions from our side as we prepare procurement/legal review:

1) Roles: we need explicit language confirming that DataCorp is the Controller and Redwood is the Processor for customer data flowing through the integration. Can you point us to the exact clause in your proposed MSA/DPA?

2) Transfers: we assume EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) will be the mechanism for cross-border transfers. Do you have a standalone SCCs addendum or do you prefer to fold the text into the DPA? Any precedents you can share would help accelerate our legal review.

3) Subprocessors & evidence: our procurement team requires a simple evidence pack — subprocessor list, SOC2 report pointer, and a short cutsheet describing where data is processed and how caching/batching is controlled. Can you provide those or confirm timelines?

Attached: DataCorp_OrderForm_v3.pdf (track changes)

Can we set a 30-minute sync later today or tomorrow to align on the approach?

Best,
Michael
Sr. Procurement Manager
DataCorp

Michael —

Thanks, and great questions. High level answers first, then proposed next steps: 

- Roles: Redwood is the Processor; DataCorp is the Controller. We will add a clear "Controller/Processor" clause cross-referenced in the MSA and mirrored in the DPA. I recommend we reference MSA §2.3 (roles) and include an explicit responsibility table as a DPA exhibit.

- Transfers/SCCs: We use the EU SCCs as a standalone addendum (Redwood_SCCs_Addendum). That keeps the DPA concise and gives your legal team a canonical doc to attach to the order form. Ill attach our DPA playbook with the standard SCCs approach. If you prefer folded text, we can provide that too.

- Evidence & subprocessors: I can share our current subprocessor roster and SOC 2 report pointer; ops can produce a 1-page "ops cut-sheet" summarizing regions, caching, and KV cache behavior.

Proposed next steps (quick):
1) I will send the Redwood_DPA_playbook_v1 + Redwood_SCCs_Addendum (playbook attached) by EOD.
2) Karthik (Legal) to provide targeted DPA redlines and language suggestions for the MSA cross-reference.
3) Ben / Ops to produce the 1-page cutsheet and subprocessor list.
4) Schedule 30-min sync with your legal & procurement — suggest 3:30pm PT today or 10am PT tomorrow.

If that works Ill raise a HubSpot task and share a DocuSign plan for the final order form + DPA bundle.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Privacy & Contracts | Redwood Inference
